newsitems.title: Stage Tour Setlist Grows to 10 Confirmed Songs

newsitems.contents: Ever since revealing the first seven songs from the Stage Tour Closed Alpha setlist, one question has continued to come up:"What other songs will be in Stage Tour?"Today, we're excited to reveal three more songs joining the growing Stage Tour setlist, bringing even more pop-punk, alternative rock, and attitude to the game Newly Announced Tracks"Bite Me" — Avril Lavigne"Airhead" — Honey Revenge"For A Pessimist, I'm Pretty Optimistic" — Paramore These latest additions expand the Stage Tour soundtrack with even more modern pop-punk, alternative rock, and arena-ready energy. newsitems.title: RedOctane's 'next evolution in rhythm gaming' sure looks a lot like 2007's Rock Band
newsitems.author: Andy Chalk
newsitems.contents: For a brief period in the early 2000s, RedOctane was a big deal. It peaked in 2005 as the publisher of Guitar Hero, leading Activision to acquire it the following year, but just a few years after that the ride was over: Amidst massive market oversaturation and flagging interest among players, Activision shuttered the whole thing in 2010... Read more.
